description: This file defines the ApplicationInsightsClient class for interacting with Amazon CloudWatch Application Insights service in PHP, including method signatures for various asynchronous and synchronous operations.

classes.name: ApplicationInsightsClient
classes.description: Client class used to interact with AWS Application Insights service, extending the AwsClient base class.

methods.name: addWorkload
methods.description: Adds a workload to the Application Insights service.

methods.name: addWorkloadAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a workload to the Application Insights service.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new Application Insights application.

methods.name: createApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new Application Insights application.
